name: aurora-background

frames.best_why: Cleanest bright white-blue band against the dark field, with the caption still legible.

tagline: Soft blurred light bands drift across a dark page behind your content.
summary: A full-bleed animated backdrop of out-of-focus white and blue streaks over a near-black field. It drifts slowly and continuously, wrapping whatever children you place on it.
appearance: A near-black stage filled by a soft, out-of-focus vertical gradient: broad white and pale blue streaks blurring into indigo, with a faint warm brown edge. A small white caption sits in the middle.
behaviour: The blurred bands drift slowly sideways and shift in brightness, never settling, so the backdrop keeps moving behind its content. Nothing reacts to the pointer.
demo_content: The words 'Aurora Background' in white at the centre of the stage.
search_phrases: soft blurred light bands behind content
animated sky glow behind a hero
ambient color wash for a landing page
full screen gradient with soft glow
use_when: A hero or landing section needs an ambient backdrop that moves slowly without stealing attention.
avoid_when: The blur and drifting motion cost paint on low-end phones, and there is no reduced-motion stop.
customise: Wrap your content as children and turn the corner fade off with showRadialGradient; the band colours live in inline CSS variables you edit by hand.
weight_why: One blurred gradient layer animated in CSS; no canvas or script.

a11y.note: No reduced-motion check, so the drifting gradient keeps moving for users who ask motion to stop.

issues: Heavy blur turns the repeating streaks into a flat smear, with little colour visible.
polish_why: Soft believable drift, but blur flattens the bands and the white caption fades on bright areas.
